text:
Sam: Quick exec weeknote — reading time ~3m. High-level: we shipped EU private beta canary, saw a 2.3% error spike during the rollout window, and unit hosting cost is down ~7% after batching tweaks. Three priority asks below.

Sam: 1) Stabilize EU beta: reduce error-spike window to <30m within the next two sprints. 2) Institute a temporary freeze on non-critical hires for 4 weeks while we hit cost targets. 3) Approve a $150k pool for 6-week 'innovation sprints' (small experiments on batching/quantization). Product & Applied ML: please submit 1-paragraph charters by next Wed.

Sam: Quick metrics snapshot: rolling 7d p50 latency = 210ms (hosted), p95 = 980ms (spike related), Dedicated throughput +12% q/q, hosting unit cost -7%.

Aisha: Thanks — can leads post a 1-line owner + ETA for each ask in #eng by EOD? I'll surface to the board.

Marco: Noted on EU beta. Ops put an emergency canary rollback in motion. Adding a transient KV-cache warm step to reduce cold-start token penalties.

Devon: Hiring freeze acked. We'll surface exceptions for customer-critical roles. Claire will own exception intake + approvals.

Claire: Will build a tiny exceptions form (2 questions) and route to people-ops. ETA 48h.

Sam: Incident summary (high level): during the canary we had a badly paginated config that caused bursty routing to a legacy model backend. Patch applied at +18m; rollback completed at +44m. Root cause: a config-merge rule not covered by tests.

Marco: Snippet from the roll-forward playbook we ran: 
```
# quickfix
kubectl set env deployment/inference ROUTING_MODE=stable
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference
```

Marco: We'll add an automated guard to block that bad merge and add a pipeline test.

OpsBot: Deploy alert: EU-canary rollback completed. Incident ticket #INC-2026-442 opened.

Sam: Policy note: debug trace retention window extended from 30 -> 90 days for paid tiers to improve postmortems. Any longer retention requires a privacy review. Legal has signed off.

Aisha: Also starting a small pricing pilot with 3 enterprise customers to test dynamic burst pricing + dedicated pre-buys. Growth will coordinate outreach and success metrics.

Devon: Quick ask — can infra pause any non-essential changes this week to reduce blast radius? Ops + infra leads please confirm.

Marco: Confirmed. Infra will hold planned changes until Friday unless critical.

Sam: Recap of asks (owners + ETAs to #eng by EOD; exceptions form in 48h; config merge guard patch in next sprint; pause infra changes this week). I'll follow up next Tue with progress notes. :wave:

Aisha: +1. Clean and actionable.

Claire: Form posted: https://tiny.redwood/internal/exception-form :heavy_check_mark:

Devon: Adding a small CI eval to catch merge-rule regressions.

Sam: Thanks team — focus on reliability, measured experiments, and clear owners. Appreciated. — Sam
